home.heroTitle: Remote AI-training contract roles for credentialed specialists in Finland and Europe.
home.heroLead: I am a Finland-based Mercor contractor. I built Edithsi to give lawyers, clinicians, engineers, finance specialists, and linguists a plain-spoken overview of Mercor's public role listings—without hype or hidden terms.
home.realityHeading: What you should know before applying
home.realityIntro: Before you click any link on this site, read the core facts so you can decide whether applying makes sense for your situation:

realityPoints.title: Free to apply, no guaranteed work
realityPoints.body: Applying is completely free—never pay anyone for a job. Work is not guaranteed; many applicants wait weeks or receive no project offer at all.

realityPoints.title: Independent contractor pay in USD
realityPoints.body: If matched to a project, you work as an independent contractor and are usually paid weekly via Stripe in US dollars.

realityPoints.title: Your local tax & benefit rules apply
realityPoints.body: Taxes depend on where you live. In Finland, for example, consider toiminimi, prepayment tax, YEL pension insurance from EUR 9,423/year work income (2026), and reporting self-employment before starting if on unemployment benefits.

realityPoints.title: Why I run this guide
realityPoints.body: I run this website independently as one Finland-based contractor. Every Mercor link on this site includes my referral code, and I may earn a referral bonus if you apply and work on a project.

home.featuredSub: Summarised from public listings. Rates are posted ranges, not guaranteed.

howPage.title: How it works & honest FAQ
howPage.lead: AI-training platforms need domain specialists to write prompts, evaluate model outputs, and verify reasoning. Here is how the process works in practice, followed by eight factual answers.
howPage.stepsHeading: How the application and contract process works

steps.title: Choose a role that fits your credentials
steps.body: Select a listing on Mercor that matches your degree, licence, or professional background. You submit your application and credentials directly to Mercor at zero cost.

steps.title: Wait for project matching (not guaranteed)
steps.body: Being in the pool does not mean immediate work. Many people wait weeks or are never matched to a project.

steps.title: Contract work and weekly USD payouts
steps.body: When assigned to an active project, you work as an independent contractor. Payouts are usually processed weekly via Stripe in US dollars, and you handle your own national taxes and social insurance.

howPage.faqIntro: I only publish verified facts below. Read these carefully before submitting an application.

faqs.question: 1. Does it cost anything to apply?
faqs.answer: It is free to apply; never pay anyone for a job.

faqs.question: 2. Am I guaranteed to get work after applying?
faqs.answer: Work is not guaranteed; many people wait weeks or get no project.

faqs.question: 3. How and in what currency am I paid?
faqs.answer: You are paid as an independent contractor, usually weekly via Stripe, in US dollars.

faqs.question: 4. How do taxes and pension insurance work?
faqs.answer: Taxes depend on your country. Finland example: toiminimi, prepayment tax, and YEL pension insurance from EUR 9,423/year work income (2026). This is not tax advice.

faqs.question: 5. What if I receive unemployment benefits?
faqs.answer: If you are on unemployment benefit, report self-employment before you start.

faqs.question: 6. How can I verify that an email from Mercor is genuine?
faqs.answer: Real Mercor emails end in @mercor.com; project accounts use @mercor.expert.

faqs.question: 7. Who receives my application data, and what about data security?
faqs.answer: You share your data with Mercor directly; Mercor reported a security incident in March 2026.

faqs.question: 8. Who runs Edithsi and how is it funded?
faqs.answer: The site is run by one Finland-based Mercor contractor who may earn a referral bonus.
